title: Discourse markers in a paragraph
subtitle: Follow addition, contrast, reason, and conclusion.
overview: A paragraph is not a string of translated clauses. Mark καί, δέ, γάρ, οὖν, and ἀλλά to see how its argument or story moves.
In A2 Core, give the relation first (addition, contrast, reason, inference), then choose natural English.

items.grc: ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν, καὶ σκοτία οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ οὐδεμία.
items.en: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.

items.grc: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ περιπατῶμεν, κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετ᾽ ἀλλήλων.
items.en: But if we walk in the light, we have fellowship with one another.
